china-1923:p1020_1.rationale: Continuation of customs export statistics listing manufactured goods, gold and silver bullion and coins by quantity and value for 1919-1921. Gold and silver rows are only some of many rows, so they are not tagged separately.

china-1923:p1021_1.rationale: Direct trade values, imports from and exports to each country (Hongkong, Macao, Indo-China, Siam, Singapore, India, Britain, Germany and others), 1917-1921, with totals per country.

china-1923:p1023_1.rationale: Direct trade values with European countries (Netherlands, Belgium, France, Spain, Portugal, Switzerland, Italy), split into imports and exports for 1917-1921.

china-1923:p1024_1.rationale: Direct trade values with Austria-Hungary, Russian ports and land frontier, and Korea, as imports and exports for 1917-1921.

china-1923:p1025_1.rationale: Direct trade values with Japan, the Philippines, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Central America, and South America as imports and exports, 1917-1921.

china-1923:p1026_1.rationale: Direct trade with Australasia and South Africa, followed by grand totals of imports, less re-exports to foreign countries, net imports and exports for 1917-1921.

china-1923:p1027_1.rationale: Whole trade of each Manchurian port, 1920-1921, split into net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports with port totals. The context calls them treaty ports, but the table is not organised around the treaty-port system, so that tag is not used.

china-1923:p1028_1.rationale: Whole trade of each port (Dairen, Tientsin, Chefoo, Hankow, Nanking and others), 1920-1921, split into net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports with totals.

china-1923:p1030_1.rationale: Whole trade of each port (Shanghai, Soochow, Hangchow, Ningpo, Amoy, Swatow and others), 1920-1921, split into net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports with totals.

china-1923:p1031_1.rationale: Whole trade of Canton and the Canton River ports (Kowloon, Lappa, Kongmoon, Wuchow and others), 1920-1921, split into net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports with totals.
